note: Maintained by the self-learn Routing & Intent phase (2.6). keywords are lowercased substrings matched against the user prompt; hint is the one-line nudge injected by the UserPromptSubmit hook (~/.claude/hooks/skill-router.py on a clone install, delivered by the plugin otherwise). Every keyword should cite, in intent-lexicon.md, the session that motivated it. Seeded with the engine's own triggers; self-learn adds YOUR phrasings (any language, plus speech-to-text mishears) as it observes them.

rules.hint: Learn from recent work / evolve the setup -> /self-learn (or /kaizen:self-learn under the plugin) (resumable, snapshot-first, propose by default).
Model/effort cost routing -> /model-balance (evidence from ccusage, backup-first edits).
Audit an unattended / scheduled loop before trusting it -> /loop-audit.
Review and confirm your day in Hoply -> /kaizen:hoply-day (or /hoply-day on a clone install); writes only after your yes.
